description:
✨ She was supposed to rule a kingdom, but now she wears the uniform of a humble maid...

Stripped of her royal heritage and forced to hide among humans, a runaway elf princess takes on a servant's identity in a high noble estate. To protect her realm and stay alive, she must obey every command while keeping her powerful magical bloodline secret from those who hunt her kind.

As dangerous court intrigue deepens and suspicions arise, every day becomes a high-stakes tightrope walk. How long can she keep her true identity hidden when dark forces close in?

💬 What do you think will happen next? Share your thoughts in the comments!

👍 If you enjoyed this fantasy story, don't forget to like, subscribe, and turn on notifications for more updates!
